title: DHCP Snooping
description: Protect the network from rogue DHCP servers with DHCP snooping.
scenario: Protect the network from rogue DHCP servers with DHCP snooping.

concepts.title: DHCP Snooping
concepts.body: DHCP snooping filters DHCP messages. Only trusted ports (uplinks) can send DHCP offers. Rogue DHCP servers are blocked.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# ip dhcp snooping
SW1(config)# ip dhcp snooping vlan 1

concepts.title: Trusted vs Untrusted
concepts.body: Trusted ports connect to legitimate DHCP servers (uplinks). Untrusted ports (access) cannot send DHCP offers.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# interface GigabitEthernet0/1
SW1(config-if)# ip dhcp snooping trust

concepts.title: Verifying
concepts.body: "show ip dhcp snooping" shows snooping status, VLANs, and trusted ports.
concepts.code:
SW1# show ip dhcp snooping
DHCP snooping is enabled
VLAN 1: enabled
Gi0/1: trusted
